title: Fema / RBI | Bank Cannot Be Forced to Reconsider Rejected OTS Proposal: Calcutta HC
description: High Court declines to entertain WPA 25935 of 2026, holding that a bank cannot be compelled by mandamus to reconsider a rejected one-time settlement proposal.The post Bank Cannot Be Forced to Reconsider Rejected OTS Proposal: Calcutta HC appeared first on TaxGuru.
